supportingSources.label: Kineticist Jungle, Wild Life, and Jungle King overview

strategy.summary: Shoot up the side rollover arcs to build the 10,000-point bonus while using left-side feeds for the kickback and right-side feeds for the outlane gate, then farm side rollovers for 1,000 each at full bonus without forcing irregular center shots.

quickInfo.name: Rollover arcs
quickInfo.summary: Five rollovers line each side of the playfield; they advance bonus and become worth 1,000 each after bonus reaches 10,000.

quickInfo.name: Left protection
quickInfo.summary: The left side lane or left return lane activates the kickback in the left outlane.

quickInfo.name: Right protection
quickInfo.summary: The right side lane or right return lane opens the gate at the right outlane.

quickInfo.name: Replay-family double
quickInfo.summary: On Jungle and Wild Life, bonus doubles automatically on the last ball and cannot be doubled earlier.

quickInfo.name: Add-A-Ball double
quickInfo.summary: On Jungle King, the top-center skill shot lights double bonus; it can be earned on any ball but is never automatic.

steps.text: Identify the exact sibling and read whether double bonus is automatic on the last ball or must be lit at the top center.
On Jungle King, plunge through the top-center lane to light double bonus; on the replay siblings, plunge for the safer side arc.
Send early controlled shots up the left arc or left side lane to establish the outlane kickback.
Use a right-side feed to open the right outlane gate when that route returns safely.
Continue UTAD through the side rollover arcs to advance bonus toward 10,000.
After bonus is full, treat every side rollover as a 1,000-point repeat and favor the better-returning side.
Avoid forcing the center bumper and standups when their irregular rebounds have not been mapped.
On the final ball of Jungle or Wild Life, preserve the automatic doubled bonus rather than chasing a marginal center score.

fallback.title: Best-side rollover repeat
fallback.when: Use this when one side arc clearly returns more safely than the other or one protection feature is unreliable.

steps.text: Choose the side whose full arc and lane feed have produced the cleanest returns.
Verify its kickback or gate state before committing.
Repeat the side feed to advance Bonus and learn each rollover exit.
Use only small legal corrections before the ball reaches the lower sling.
Switch sides only when the preferred protection is unavailable or the return pattern changes.

alternatives.title: Full-bonus rollover farming
alternatives.when: Use this after the bonus display reaches 10,000 and a side arc is returning reliably.

steps.text: Confirm that bonus is capped and the side rollovers now award 1,000 each.
Shoot the safer side arc rather than the center targets.
Count the rollovers collected on each trip.
Stop farming after a dangerous lateral exit or loss of outlane protection.
Activate the left kickback.
Roll through the right side lane or return lane to open the right outlane gate when that feed is safe.
Advance bonus through the two five-rollover arcs.
Secure the correct double-bonus condition for the exact sibling.
At 10,000 bonus, continue only through the safer rollover arc for 1,000-point switches.

techniques.name: Side-arc UTAD
techniques.instruction: Aim above the lower sling and into the five-rollover arc, then track how ball speed and angle affect every exit.

techniques.name: Protection-state check
techniques.instruction: Before repeating a side, verify that the left kickback is active or the right gate is visibly open.

techniques.name: Jungle King skill plunge
techniques.instruction: On the Add-A-Ball sibling, align the plunge for the top-center lane that lights double bonus for the current ball.

cautions.issue: Side rollover arcs can return at irregular angles and speeds.
cautions.response: Study the first few exits, favor the safer side, and change the plan when a feed begins reaching a sling or outlane.

cautions.issue: The center bumper, standups, and side lanes all produce machine-dependent rebounds.
cautions.response: Do not assume a standard feed; keep both flippers ready and use only early legal nudges.

cautions.issue: The double-bonus rule changes between the replay and Add-A-Ball siblings.
cautions.response: Confirm the exact title before the plunge: Jungle and Wild Life use last-ball double, while Jungle King must light it at top center.

strategy.simpleOverview: Jungle / Wild Life / Jungle King uses ten side rollovers to raise base bonus to 10,000, after which each side rollover scores 1,000. Use left-side feeds to activate the left kickback and a safe right-side feed to open the right outlane gate, then keep sending the ball up the better-returning side arc.
strategy.overview: Jungle / Wild Life / Jungle King raises bonus through the ten side rollovers. Establish the left kickback, use a right side lane or return lane to open the right gate, and repeat controlled up-the-drain side feeds until bonus reaches 10,000. Afterward, farm the 1,000-point rollovers and preserve the sibling-specific doubled bonus.
